changelog: Add: Backtesting Phase 1b — the module is renamed from "Chart" to "Backtesting" (same nav slot; the candles/candle_sync/symbols pipeline and its CLI scripts are unchanged, per the briefing). Session setup (symbol, replay timeframe, start date, risk %, fee rate, blind mode) plus fully custom challenge rules (account size, profit target %, daily/max drawdown %, static or trailing, max trades/day) that never require an existing challenge and stay editable even after a convenience prefill. Sessions persist and resume exactly where they left off.

Add: no-lookahead replay engine — the server (BacktestController::getCandles()) clamps every candle response to the session's own replay_cursor_ms, regardless of what a client asks for; the browser is never trusted to hide future data. Controls: next bar, jump to latest (batched, capped per request), play/pause at 1x-10x, timeframe switch, view-only scrollback. Placing an order while viewing an earlier bar is blocked server-side.

Add: order simulation — market and limit orders, long and short, with required stop-loss and optional take-profit. Position size is risk % of current equity ÷ stop distance; fees are charged independently on entry and exit at the session's own fee rate; fills are evaluated bar-by-bar against each bar's high/low (stop-loss wins if a single bar touches both levels — a deliberately conservative tie-break). Pure fill/P&L/fee/drawdown math lives in includes/backtest_engine.php and is unit-tested standalone (php includes/backtest_engine.php).

Add: challenge simulation — a live panel showing progress to target, today's loss vs. the daily drawdown limit, distance to max drawdown (static or trailing), and trades used today. Rules are enforced, not just displayed: max trades/day blocks new entries; either drawdown rule breached fails the session immediately, force-closing any open position and freezing the reason/bar/equity; reaching the profit target passes it, recording trading days and trade count. Equity and peak equity are never stored columns — always derived live from trades, the same fix challenges.current_balance already needed in this codebase (v3.13.0) applied here before it could repeat.

Add: backtest trades write into the existing trades table (source='backtest' extends the existing ENUM, plus backtest_session_id and a NULL challenge_id — the only value legal against trades.challenge_id's own foreign key that's never mistakable for a real challenge). Every existing reader of trades that could have been affected was audited and patched to exclude source='backtest' explicitly: StatsController, AlertController, TradeController::getAll(), ReviewEngineController (three "all combined" branches), ReportCardAiController, StrategyBuilderController::getLeaderboard(). See docs/backtesting-pipeline.md §13 for the full reasoning and file list.

Migration (manual — see release notes below): migrations/2026_09_25_0001_create_backtest_tables.sql adds backtest_sessions, backtest_pending_orders, and extends trades. Every statement is individually safe to retry.
release_notes: MANUAL DB STEP REQUIRED, not run by this release: after Update Now, run migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run to apply migrations/2026_09_25_0001_create_backtest_tables.sql (creates backtest_sessions/backtest_pending_orders, widens trades.source to add 'backtest', adds trades.backtest_session_id + its FK). That migration file is deliberately NOT in this release's files list or db_migrations below, same pattern as every prior backtesting migration in this project (v3.18.1, v3.19.0) -- it must never be auto-copied into the live migrations/ folder outside a real release's own files list. It IS committed to the repo for history and manual reference. Also note: pages/chart.php (deployed by v3.19.0) is superseded by the new pages/backtest.php and is no longer referenced by index.php -- safe to delete from the live server manually, not required (the updater has no file-deletion mechanism, only add/overwrite).
